text:
Mark Stone has 10 goals in 19 games, and the Vegas captain is doing what he has always done: winning pucks, killing plays, and making the right pass. Evolving-Hockey had him third among all forwards in wins above replacement last season, with a defensive impact in the 94th percentile, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking ranked him a 96th-percentile setup man.

The goals are the part that will not last. He is shooting 27% on 37 shots, against a normal range for him of about 15 to 20%, and Vegas has scored 9.6 more goals than expected with him on the ice. His last ten games have been quieter, 8 points against about 10 we'd expect, and his own chances in that stretch were thin (2.4 expected goals against 3.6 usual).

None of that changes his value. A 178th overall pick who became one of the league's best two-way wingers does not need a 27% shooting rate. Our projection lands him around 33 goals and 87 points.
headline: Stone's shooting is running very hot
